title: Data: AI Compute Cost and Token Economics (2026)
tags: [ai, compute, token-economics, cost, gpu, electricity, inference, data-centres]
oneliner: **Key dynamic:** Token prices have declined by ~95% in four years. This is not primarily margin compression — it reflects genuine hardware cost improvement (H100 → B200 → TPU v7) and model efficiency gains (smaller models achieving same benchmark scores). The decline is likely to continue but is now slowing as silicon and electricity costs hit physical limits.

title: Data: Hyperscaler AI Revenue — Azure / AWS / GCP / Oracle (June 2026)
tags: [hyperscaler, microsoft, amazon, google, oracle, azure, aws, gcp, oci, stargate, cloud, ai-revenue, capex, demand-layer]
oneliner: **The one-line picture:** Google Cloud +63%, AWS +28%, Azure AI ARR +123%, Oracle OCI +93% — all four are accelerating into 2026. The hyperscalers' AI revenues are real and growing, and they are spending ahead of revenue at a ratio that has never been seen in cloud history. Oracle's $638B RPO backlog — up 363% YoY — is the starkest single data point of locked-in AI infrastructure demand.

title: Data: TSMC — CoWoS Packaging, Process Nodes & AI Revenue (June 2026)
tags: [tsmc, cowos, advanced-packaging, n3, n2, ai-chips, foundry, semiconductor, layer-2, layer-3]
